label: York Reference / Ref. No.
requiredness: Required at commit; incomplete allowed in local draft
handling: Text; trim/case normalization per server; preserve leading zeroes. Do not reserve by local save.

label: Project name
handling: Preserve full name; use wrapping or disclosure in headings. No forced all-caps input.

label: Client / end user
handling: Existing readable party input; search enhancement only if authorized master is available. No implicit contact/account creation.

label: Contract / Job No.
handling: Text, not a money field; preserve punctuation and leading zeroes.

label: Site location
handling: Readable address/location text. Do not require GPS or geocoding.

label: Start date
requiredness: Optional; Today is an explicit helper
handling: ISO date at boundary. Do not silently stamp today into restored or edited empty data.

label: Expected end date
handling: If both dates exist, end >= start; preserve absent versus entered.

label: Project notes
handling: Multiline plain text; preserve paragraphs. No financial or security commands hidden in notes.

label: Contact name / phone / email / address
handling: Preserve existing hidden values on edit. Validate only entered values and current supported constraints.

label: Consultant
handling: One party of this kind; clearing is a deliberate edit.

label: Main contractor
handling: One party of this kind; show typed pending value before list/step change.

label: Subcontractors
handling: Stable local row identity; explicit add/remove with recoverable input. Duplicate warning does not merge history.

label: Other contractors
handling: Never reinterpret legacy authorityRef. Names do not grant access.

label: Project team
handling: Eligible directory records only; activation needs active PE. Site Engineer creation exception remains bounded.

label: Physical buildings
requiredness: At least one named building at commit
handling: Common is system-created and excluded from physical count. No default building inferred from title.

label: Building code
handling: Current base SQL canonical format: 1–64 ASCII letters/digits/_/- starting alphanumeric, normalized case. Verify later overrides.

label: Building name
handling: Not required until row is being applied/committed; reject whitespace-only.

label: Floors / levels
handling: Examples B1, Ground, L1, Roof. “3” is a label unless an explicit separate count feature is approved.

label: Delivery address
handling: Offer explicit Copy site location, not an invisible changing link.

label: Has FRP room
requiredness: Boolean per building; retained default false
handling: True/false must round-trip exactly. No FRP capacity field; no inheritance from another building unless explicitly copied.

label: Existing building identity
requiredness: Mandatory internal identity for retained edit rows
handling: Hidden immutable reference. Preserve through draft reload and update; never recreate it from the code/name.

label: Project documents
handling: Metadata is not uploaded evidence; bytes may require reselection. File policy from controlled document service.
